implementation.targetScope: React 19.3 object/default/slot props, classes, DOM/shadow helpers, refs, controlled state, stable callbacks, timer/focus hooks, validators and MUI 9 roving menu/tab registry reached by current and app-pinned System/Material callers. Native modern-browser focus-visible; no legacy browser polyfill or local-storage hook.

changes: Uses React and vclsx instead of Babel runtime, prop-types, @types/prop-types, @mui/types and react-is runtime dependencies.
Own-property class dictionaries avoid inherited global-state names; recursive assignment treats prototype-named keys as data and rejects source cycles.
Callback-ref composition preserves React 19 cleanups and attempts every cleanup even if one fails. Stable event callbacks update only after commit.
DOM ownership and shadow-root traversal stay local to the supplied document; native focus-visible removes legacy input-mode listeners.
Runtime validators remain active and allow React 19 function component refs; development diagnostic wording is not copied.

caller.scope: App has no direct @mui/utils imports; imports are reached through Material/System. Unchanged 9.5.0 and app 7.2.0 forms, menus, tabs, dialogs and styling are tested with their utility dependency fully replaced.
